title: Efficiently Learning Branching Networks for Multitask Algorithmic Reasoning

problem.claim: A single model capable of performing well on multiple algorithmic reasoning tasks is desirable.

gap.claim: Training multiple algorithmic reasoning tasks together is challenging because differing algorithm execution steps cause negative interference.

narrative_sequence.summary: Algorithmic reasoning is a core benchmark for evaluating reasoning in GNNs and LLMs.
A single model should ideally perform well across multiple algorithmic reasoning tasks.
Different algorithm execution steps create negative interference during joint training.
